title: Quaint Smoky Middle Eastern Borlotti Beans Musakhan
description: A smoky and pillowy Middle Eastern dish featuring borlotti beans, this musakhan is a nostalgic and whole30-friendly option for a weeknight dinner. It is made with poached borlotti beans and smoky spices.
instructions: Rinse the dried borlotti beans and soak them in water for at least 8 hours.
Drain and rinse the soaked borlotti beans, then transfer them to a large pot.
Add the chicken broth to the pot and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 45 minutes.
While the borlotti beans are cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Stir in the smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Once the borlotti beans are cooked, drain them and add them to the skillet with the smoky spice mixture.
Toss the borlotti beans to coat them with the smoky spice mixture and serve hot.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
